description: This file defines the MaintenanceVisit class, a subclass of TransactionBase, implementing logic for maintenance visit records including validation, status updates, and related document updates within an ERP system.

classes.name: MaintenanceVisit
classes.description: Represents a maintenance visit record with methods for validation, status updates, and related document management.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for activity feed, indicating the customer related to the maintenance visit.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates that serial numbers in purposes exist in the Serial No database.

methods.name: validate_maintenance_date
methods.description: Ensures the maintenance date falls within the scheduled start and end dates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs overall validation by calling serial number and maintenance date validations.

methods.name: update_completion_status
methods.description: Updates the completion status of the maintenance schedule detail.

methods.name: update_actual_date
methods.description: Updates the actual maintenance date in the schedule detail.

methods.name: update_customer_issue
methods.description: Updates related warranty claim documents based on maintenance visit status and purposes.

methods.name: check_if_last_visit
methods.description: Checks if this is the last maintenance visit for a given purpose and prevents cancellation if not.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the maintenance visit is submitted, including updating statuses and related documents.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the maintenance visit is canceled, including validation and status update.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Placeholder for actions on update; currently does nothing.
